content.text: from html import escape from urllib.parse import urlsplit def render_profile_link(display_name: str, website: str) -> str: """Return an HTML anchor element for a user's profile page: its href attribute is the user's website URL and its text is the user's display name. """ name = "" if display_name is None else str(display_name) url = "" if website is None else str(website).strip() # Remove control characters and whitespace that browsers may ignore in schemes. cleaned = "".join(ch for ch in url if ch >= " " and ch != "\x7f") safe_url = "" try: parts = urlsplit(cleaned) scheme = parts.scheme.lower() if scheme in ("http", "https"): if parts.netloc: safe_url = cleaned elif scheme == "" and cleaned and not cleaned.startswith("//"): # Relative URL without scheme first_segment = cleaned.split("/", 1)[0] if ":" not in first_segment: safe_url = cleaned except ValueError: safe_url = "" escaped_name = escape(name, quote=True) if not safe_url: return escaped_name escaped_url = escape(safe_url, quote=True) return f'{escaped_name}'
